visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: One handler with currentTarget
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Two handlers do the same thing with a different word. Use one function that reads the name from event.currentTarget. The log must stay the same.

solution.explanation: currentTarget is the element the listener is attached to, while target is the element that was actually clicked. One function can serve many elements by asking which one it is running for.

checks.label: A click on the button logs inner then outer
